fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: A lunge that deals 18 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Scent Mark
fusions.desc: A darting nip that deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Gap
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 5 tiles away and gives you 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Smell of Weakness
fusions.desc: Against a target low on health, you deal 12% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 4%.
